spans.s:
शौव a. (वी f.) [श्वन्-अण् टिलोपः]
Relating to dogs, canine.
--वं
1 A
pack of dogs.
--2 The state or
nature of a dog.

सौव a. (वी f.)
1 Relating to
one's own property.
--2 Being in
or belonging to heaven.
--वं An
order, edict. (?).

शौवन a. (नी f.)
1 Canine.
--2
Having the qualities of a dog.
--नं
1 The nature of a dog.
--2 The
progeny of a dog.

शौवस्तिक a. (की f.) [श्वस्-ठक्
[]
तुट् च] Belonging to or lasting till
to-morrow, ephemeral.

सौवस्तिक a. (की f.)
Benedictive.
--कः A family-priest or
Brāhmaṇa.

शौवापद a. (दी f.) [श्वापद-अण्]
1 Relating to a wild beast.
--2
Savage, fierce, wild.

सौवग्रामिक a. (की f.) Belonging
to one's own village.

सौवर a. (री f.)
1 Belonging to
sound or a musical note.
--2
Treating of accents.

सौवर्चल a. (ली f.) Coming
from the country called सुवर्चल
q. v.
--लं
1 Sochal salt.
--2 Natron.

सौवर्ण a. (र्णी f.)
1 Golden.
--2
Weighing one Suvarṇa q. v.
--Comp.
--भेदिनी the plant Priyaṅgu.

सौवाध्यायिक a. (की f.)
Belonging to sacred study (or स्वाध्याय
q. v.)

सौवास्तव a. (वी f.) Having a
good site, pleasantly situated or
placed.

1 The fruit of the jujube.
--2 Antimony.
--3 Sour gruel.
--रः
N. of a district or its people (pl. in
the latter^1 sense).
--Comp.
--अंजनं a
kind of antimony or collyrium.
--सारः
antimony.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar and Jim Funderburk on 20210104. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/20.

1 The jujube tree.
--2
An inhabitant of Suvīra.
--3 N.
of Jayadratha.
--कं Sour
barleygruel.
